answer: Dune crest bond: each identity takes one dune crest, posts 70, and files a cipher-signed pulse of crest height per epoch. The auditor checks it on the dune-migration table; off by over 3%, a reused serial, or a missing pulse burns the bond. First filing 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented readings carry the owner's key, so a second filing burns both; honest agents pay 38 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
